scope: Synthetic 30-second 1920x1080 testsrc2; one JPEG per second; no user media and no provider request
observation: In this bounded extraction test, 1080p took about 11.8% longer and produced about 84.2% more JPEG bytes. This measures extraction and payload size only, not recognition accuracy or token cost.
decision: Use low-detail 720p representatives by default. Escalate only selected low-confidence or fine-detail frames to 1080p; do not generate mass 4K PNGs.
limitations: Synthetic imagery is not a substitute for a representative travel-scene accuracy evaluation.
No live OpenAI or Gemini call was made, so quality and billed-token differences remain unverified.
